scope: Scènes A1/A2 produites après la clôture de la revue des 1 021 questions et le classement des 346 supports ; aucun QCM ou audio modifié par ce lot.

images.label: Demander une salle à l’école
images.prompt: Résumé du brief de génération : Variation de la scène de demande de salle : deux nouveaux personnages, jeune femme aux cheveux noirs courts et homme plus âgé à peau foncée ; couloir sans numéro, étage, drapeau ni texte, mains et pieds dans le cadre. Même peinture douce, contours discrets, lumière naturelle et paysage 4:3.
images.visual_review: Deux personnes nouvelles et portes sans numéro : la source ne donne ni salle 12 ni étage. Le membre du personnel est un homme comme le destinataire de la demande. Aucune nationalité attribuée par le visage.

images.label: Choisir un pendentif en bijouterie
images.prompt: Résumé du brief de génération : Variation dans une bijouterie : vendeuse plus âgée aux cheveux argentés et jeune homme à peau brune examinant un pendentif argenté en forme de tour Eiffel, écrin et quelques bracelets, sans prix ni argent. Peinture semi-réaliste douce et cadrage paysage 4:3.
images.visual_review: Vendeuse et jeune client distincts, pendentif argenté en forme de tour Eiffel lisible dans son écrin ; aucun prix, monnaie ou âge écrit. Le décor ne prétend pas être un magasin réel identifié.

images.label: Demander du désinfectant et des pansements
images.prompt: Résumé du brief de génération : Variation de pharmacie : remplacer la pharmacienne par un homme à peau foncée, un jeune cycliste roux indique sa jambe douloureuse, désinfectant non étiqueté et boîte de pansements à pictogramme, vélo secondaire, sans dose ni prix. Peinture douce en paysage 4:3.
images.visual_review: Pharmacien homme conforme à Monsieur ; jeune cycliste montrant le tibia, flacon et boîte avec pictogramme de pansement, vélo au second plan. Aucun dosage, diagnostic, sang, fracture, prix ou compte de comprimés inventé.

images.label: Se faire aider pour prendre deux paquets de biscuits
images.prompt: Edit this approved illustration into a different grocery-store scene. Preserve the approved warm softly painted semi-realistic educational style, restrained natural colours, fine unobtrusive outlines, realistic anatomy and friendly expressions. Native canvas 1448 x 1086 pixels, EXACT 4:3 LANDSCAPE, not square and not 3:2. New characters with completely different faces: a middle-aged woman with warm brown skin and straight shoulder-length dark hair uses a manual wheelchair in a grocery aisle. She politely asks a young adult man with fair skin and short blond hair to reach biscuits on a HIGH shelf. He is retrieving EXACTLY TWO IDENTICAL YELLOW PACKETS of biscuits: one yellow packet in his raised hand and the second in his lower hand. The shelf above has an obvious empty space where they came from. Both packets have the same plain simple packaging, same brown round biscuit pictogram, no letters or numbers, no brand names. All other background groceries have other colours so only these TWO yellow packets are prominent. Show the high shelf and the help gesture clearly; no basket of fruit instead of biscuits. Accessible wide aisle, whole wheelchair and wheels fully visible, both people's complete heads and hands, man's feet within frame with margin. No prices, receipts, money, calendar, dates, days, months, watermark, speech bubbles, or signage. This is an inclusive scene of practical help, with no diagnosis or identity label.
images.visual_review: Deux paquets jaunes identiques seulement : l’un dans la main levée, l’autre dans la main basse. Rayon haut et espace accessible ; femme en fauteuil et jeune homme aux visages différents. Le fauteuil est un choix illustratif inclusif, pas une information à déduire de l’audio ou une réponse sur la cause de la difficulté.

images.label: Emprunter l’anorak bleu
images.prompt: Transform this approved illustration into a new scene of two young friends borrowing outdoor clothing. Keep the same warm painted semi-realistic educational art direction, fine natural outlines, believable fabric, gentle daylight and human expressions. Native canvas MUST be 1448 x 1086 pixels, EXACT 4:3 LANDSCAPE, not square or 3:2. Replace both people and all classroom elements. A Southeast Asian-looking young man with long black hair tied loosely back, wearing a plain cream T-shirt, OFFERS A BLUE ANORAK JACKET to a young woman with medium brown skin and natural short auburn curls, wearing a pale grey T-shirt. He keeps a GREEN ANORAK JACKET neatly draped over his other forearm. There must be EXACTLY TWO ANORAKS visible, one BLUE being handed over and one GREEN retained by the owner. No other coats, jackets or anoraks, no clothing on hooks that could confuse the count. Neutral bright entrance hall before an outing, simple bench and blank wall, not school, no map, mountains, flags, timetable, books or numerical labels. Both stand at a friendly distance. The blue anorak should be clearly a weatherproof hooded jacket with sleeves, not a sweater or blue bag. All hands, heads and both pairs of feet in frame, generous margins, realistic fingers. No gender stereotypes, no price, date, day, month, brand, speech bubble, watermark or text.
images.visual_review: Deux anoraks seulement, bleu offert et vert conservé sur l’autre avant-bras ; deux jeunes personnes en tee-shirt, mains et pieds complets, décor neutre sans école ou montagne imposée.

images.label: Faire emballer un cadeau en bleu
images.prompt: Edit this approved reference into a NEW gift-wrapping scene inside a small pleasant shop, keeping the exact warm softly painted semi-realistic educational style, natural colours, fine subtle lines, realistic hands, faces and materials. Native output MUST be 1448 x 1086 pixels, EXACT 4:3 LANDSCAPE, not square or 3:2. Completely different people: an East Asian-looking female shop assistant around 40 with dark hair in a ponytail and a rust-coloured cardigan wraps a gift for a young man with warm brown skin, short wavy hair and a pale yellow shirt. The single rectangular gift box is wrapped in LIGHT PALE BLUE PAPER and tied with a clearly DARK NAVY BLUE RIBBON with one tidy bow. These TWO SHADES OF BLUE must be unmistakably distinct. The woman is finishing the bow on the counter, the young man looks at the gift appreciatively. Gift contents invisible. A roll of the same light-blue paper and spool of the same navy ribbon may be on the counter, no additional wrapped gifts in other colours. Replace the ticket window, papers and computer with this retail counter and plain shelves. No birthday number, birthday cake, price, cash, dates, days, months, brand name, labels or readable text. Frame people comfortably with complete heads and hands and customer feet visible, staff naturally behind the counter. No cartoon caricature, collage, speech bubbles, watermark, extra fingers or chopped limbs.
images.visual_review: Un paquet à papier bleu clair et ruban bleu foncé ; vendeuse nouvelle terminant le nœud et jeune client, aucune date, montant, marque ou contenu de cadeau ajouté.

images.label: Se renseigner à la billetterie
images.prompt: Create a new variation of this approved ticket-office illustration, preserving the same warm softly painted semi-realistic educational rendering, natural proportions, subtle fine contours, quiet natural colours, friendly expressions and soft daylight. Native new canvas MUST be 1448 x 1086 pixels, EXACT 4:3 LANDSCAPE, not square and not 3:2. Replace the adult customer with a visibly YOUNG ADOLESCENT GIRL around 13–14, with medium brown skin, curly black hair in a low ponytail and a turquoise windbreaker over a plain shirt, small backpack. Replace the clerk with a different adult MALE around 50, fair skin, short reddish beard and thin glasses, dark green cardigan. She is asking for information politely with an open empty hand; he LISTENS and responds with an open hand, not handing over a purchase or money. Generic travel information/ticket counter with a small plain stack of ticket blanks lying to the side; no station name, no destination, no mode of transport, no prices, no schedule, no age label. No train, ship or airplane in the background: this generic desk must be reusable for different travel inquiries. A small unlabelled globe may be behind the clerk. Only two main figures, fully framed heads and hands, girl's feet and backpack complete, modest margins. No amount, date, day, month, calendar, letters, numbers, brand, flag, watermark or speech bubbles. The picture must establish a young customer talking to a male employee, without pretending an exact age can be read from a face.
images.visual_review: Jeune adolescente et préposé homme, gestes de renseignement sans achat achevé ; ni horaire, prix, destination ou mode de transport imposé. L’âge exact reste une information orale, jamais prouvée par l’apparence du personnage.
